blocks.text: Muqarrar pH ka buffer banane ke liye kamzor acid HA aur strong base jaise NaOH ke saath us ke salt NaA par ghaur karein. Dissociations HA se H+ + A- aur NaA se Na+ + A- hain. Buffer ka pH Henderson ke muadle se milta hai: pH = pKa - log([acid] / [salt]), ya, numerator aur denominator badal kar jis se log ka nishan badalta hai, pH = pKa + log([salt] / [acid]). Is liye buffer ka pH do awamil tay karte hain: istemal shuda acid ka pKa, aur salt aur acid ki concentrations ka tanasub. Behtareen buffer salt aur acid ki barabar concentrations le kar banta hai, taake pH acid ke pKa se control ho. Acetic acid-sodium acetate buffer ke liye [CH3COOH] = [CH3COONa] ke saath pH = pKa + log 1 = pKa + 0 = pKa = 4.74: is buffer ka pH acid ke pKa ke bilkul barabar hai. Jism ka khoon ka buffering system, jis mein bicarbonates shamil hain, khoon ka pH barqarar rakhne mein madad karta hai.

blocks.title: Henderson ka muadla
blocks.text: pH = pKa + log([salt] / [acid]), jahan pKa = kamzor acid ka -log Ka; barabar salt aur acid ke saath pH = pKa.

blocks.caption: Buffer pH misalein
rows: CH3COOH 0.09 M / CH3COONa 0.11 M, Ka 1.85 x 10^-5 (Quick Check 9.4e)

blocks.prompt: Ek buffer 0.50 M HF aur 0.45 M fluoride hai, HF ka Ka = 6.8 x 10^-4. 1.0 dm3 mein 0.40 g NaOH shamil karne se pehle aur baad us ka pH nikalein (Quick Check 9.4d).
blocks.explanation: pKa = -log(6.8 x 10^-4) = 3.17. Pehle: pH = 3.17 + log(0.45 / 0.50) = 3.17 - 0.046 = 3.12. 0.40 g NaOH 0.010 mol hai; yeh 0.010 mol HF ko F- mein badalta hai, to HF 0.49 M aur F- 0.46 M ho jata hai. Baad: pH = 3.17 + log(0.46 / 0.49) = 3.17 - 0.027 = 3.14. pH sirf 0.02 units barhta hai.

items: Henderson: pH = pKa + log([salt] / [acid]); pH acid ke pKa aur salt-acid tanasub par munhasir; barabar miqdarein pH = pKa deti hain (acetate buffer ke liye 4.74).
